# “Kommer onsdagens styrka på Wall Street leva vidare?”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This EFN Morgon episode (Black Friday, after Thanksgiving) is upbeat on risk appetite. Stockholm rose 2% the day before, Asian tech stocks are rallying, and the hosts talk about a possible Christmas rally. They also flag continued volatility, the credit market's concerns about Nvidia (S&P threatening a downgrade), higher oil prices from Middle East attacks, and strong US inflation that supports a rate hike. Other topics are consumer stocks on Black Friday, a hunt for defensive insurance stocks (JP Morgan upgrades on Tryg and Sampo, Barclays underweight on Securitas), M&A interest in Imperial Brands, and property disposals by Wihlborgs and Corem.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 RVRC — Revolution Race | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host thinks consumer stocks like RVRC could do well during Black Friday/Christmas month.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion, speculative: Black Friday is often a good stock market day, and consumer companies where shoppers go during the holiday season could benefit. The CEO would not say whether Black Friday or Christmas trading matters more.

#### Sell Triggers

- weak Black Friday/Christmas sales
- consumer sentiment weakens

> *"Men jag tänker ändå att ett Revolution Race eller ett Clas Ohlson är sånt som... verkligen är dit konsumenten går sådana här dagar."*

---

### 🟠 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host names Clas Ohlson as a consumer destination on Black Friday-type days.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion, speculative: consumer stocks could perform well in the holiday month, and Clas Ohlson is where consumers shop on such days.

#### Sell Triggers

- weak holiday sales
- consumer sentiment deteriorates

> *"Men jag tänker ändå att ett Revolution Race eller ett Clas Ohlson är sånt som... verkligen är dit konsumenten går sådana här dagar."*

---

### 🟢 SAMPO.HE — Sampo | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

JP Morgan upgrades Sampo to overweight; insurers seen as defensive.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion: JP Morgan moves Sampo to overweight. DI analyst Agneta Jönsson suggested insurers can provide safe portfolios. The host expects a continued hunt for defensive stocks.

#### Sell Triggers

- risk-on rotation away from defensives
- JP Morgan reverses rating

> *"men också Sampo, det finska försäkringsbolaget, till övervikt."*

---

### 🟡 TRYG.CO — Tryg | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

JP Morgan upgrades Tryg from underweight to neutral.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion: JP Morgan raises Tryg to neutral, in the context of investors hunting for defensive insurance stocks.

#### Sell Triggers

- downgrade back to underweight
- claims inflation

> *"JP Morgan höjer Trygg, till exempel från undervikt till neutral"*

---

### ⛔ SECU-B — Securitas | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Barclays initiates coverage with underweight.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion: Barclays starts covering Securitas with an underweight rating. The hosts give no further detail.

#### Sell Triggers

- Barclays upgrades
- strong earnings beat

> *"Man verkar inte gilla Securitess. Man jobbar på Barclays och inleder bevakning med undervikt på aktien."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

S&P may downgrade AA credit rating; CDS widening; extreme volatility after +30% day.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion: the credit market's protest continues. S&P flags governance weaknesses, key-man risk tied to Jensen Huang, and weak controls. A 30% one-day move is described as hysterical and likely to be followed by turbulent days. The hosts want to keep following the stock.

#### Sell Triggers

- S&P downgrade executed
- CDS spreads keep widening

> *"Nu har även S&P gått ut och flaggat för att de kan komma att nedgradera Nvidia från kreditbetyget AA inom de närmaste 90 dagarna."*

---
